family_selection: in_prespecified_family=True; database reaction support without a current specific identity hold; provisional biochemical annotation, not final causality
primary_population: GEO explicit individual, author TN=Tumor, GEO stage in stage I/II/III/IV; n=33 unique individuals
paired_normal_population: Exact GEO individual match to author TN=Normal; n=33 pairs; no ID-number inference
primary_association: Two-sided within-tumor Spearman rho, average ranks for ties; 9999 random permutations with (exceedances+1)/(B+1)
bootstrap: 4000 resamples of independent patients; recompute ranks; percentile 95% CI; report valid resample count
seed: first 8 hex digits of SHA256(version|analysis_type|metabolite_key|human_gene_id), separate generator per record; stable to row order
sensitivity_all37: Same family, all 37 author Tumor specimens including 3 adenoma and 1 stage0; separate BH family
sensitivity_availability33: Stage I-IV primary population, pairwise finite author data sheet subset; availability is not confirmed raw detection; separate BH family
rna_contrast: Within-individual stage I-IV tumor minus normal on author RNA scale; two-sided Wilcoxon signed rank, zero_method=wilcox, normal approximation with tie correction, no continuity correction; median paired difference and 4000 paired bootstrap CI; all-zero differences p=1
multiplicity: BH separately across evaluable tests in each of primary33, all37, availability33, and paired_RNA33 families; preserve planned, evaluable and unavailable counts; no candidate additions after locking
robustness: Leave-one-patient-out rho range and maximum change for every evaluable primary relationship; descriptive only, no separate significance gate
input_processing: Reuse author processed metabolomics and RNA; no additional transform, normalization, imputation, batch correction or alias guessing
covariate_adjustment: NOT_RUN in this first association batch; age, sex, stage and tissue site available for subsequent predeclared whole-family sensitivity; purity and technical batch not resolved
interpretation: Exploratory within-CAMP association, not external replication, enzyme activity, flux or causality; original CAMP q and new RNA/correlation q kept separate
